title: Recreatief gedrag van de Friese bevolking 1985
authors: Vegt, W.D.C. van der, Provincie Friesland * Leeuwarden, Hoofdgr. ruimtelijke ordening, afd. recreatie en toerisme (primary investigator)
contributors: Provincie Friesland, hoofdgroep ruimtelijke ordening, afd. recreatie en toerisme (research initiator)
Provinciale planologische dienst friesland * Leeuwarden (data collector)
descriptions: To get insight into the recreational behaviour and needs regarding recreational facilities of the Frisian population. Leisure activities last summer / areas visited in Friesland / need for additional recreational facilities in own residence / preferences and possibilities and opportunities for recreation / destination last summer holiday / recreational image of province of Friesland. Background variables: basic characteristics/ residence/ household characteristics/ occupation/employment/ income/capital assets/ education/ consumption of durables
